title: Ask, moderate, and spotlight audience Q&A
persona: A participant asks a question while a co-host moderates it for the projector.
purpose: Cover the session-wide Q&A tab, moderation desk, and stage handoff.
outcome: A participant question reaches the Q&A desk and can be spotlighted on the stage.
prerequisites: A session whose outline sets qna.enabled.

chapters.title: Ask a question from the participant tab
chapters.narration: The Q&A flow is session-wide rather than tied to one poll. The participant switches to the Q&A tab, submits a question, and sees it return as their own item.

chapters.title: Moderate and spotlight the question
chapters.narration: The Q&A desk is a separate host surface. It is where a co-host can decide what reaches the session. We find the question and spotlight it for the stage.

actions.name: Spotlight on stage: What should we revisit?
